gaps: P0: nothing. P2: nothing usable (#6 is an anonymous small copy dated only 1650–1749). P3: no candidates.
notes: #1: Commons gives 1618 (the Latin edition of vol. 6); dated 1617 per the vol. 6 rule. #10 and #11 are the two P4 views (about 47 years apart). P4 alternatives: #7 Rybkowski’s 1895 color painting of the Easter fair on Bernardine Square (landmark scene, but only 30 years after #10), and #8 Trzemeski’s 1890 general view from Kleparów (black and white). #20 (Münz, view from the Town Hall) is dated only ‘before 1924’. #15 (1942–44) shows the ruined synagogue, skipped.
